template.entry_long: close >= low + {p0} * (high - low) and open <= low + {p1} * (high - low)
template.exit_long: open >= low + 0.8 * (high - low) and close <= low + 0.2 * (high - low)
template.notes: Close in top 20% with open in bottom 20% of the bar range; exit on opposite 80-20 signal. Corpus: no stops.
